notes: Rotation-accuracy program, 2026-09-28 (owner: "survival will be a melee hunter spec"). Rewritten from a ranged-shots-plus-Raptor-Strike-weave rotation to a real melee rotation: the character starts in melee range (no prepull move -- StartDistanceFromTarget defaults to 0, well inside core.MaxMeleeAttackDistance) and never leaves it, so Aimed Shot, Multi-Shot, Arcane Shot and Serpent Sting -- every one of them gated on core.MinRangedAttackDistance (12 yd) in this engine -- are removed rather than declared inert or expected_idle: they are not lines this rotation names any more, and a spec that commits fully to melee for the whole fight cannot ever satisfy both that gate and Raptor Strike/Mongoose Bite/Counterattack/Strider Kick's core.MaxMeleeAttackDistance (5 yd) gate at once under this engine's single static per-fight distance. Wing Clip is also deliberately left out: it is a control tool (a snare/immobilize), not a damage line worth a GCD against a stationary target, matching how a real Survival player would not snare a training dummy either -- the ladder's own 'learned but unused' list will keep naming it at every level it is learned, which is the expected, reviewed state for a line this file chooses not to carry. The engine side of this rewrite is sim/hunter's melee kit: Raptor Strike and Mongoose Bite's damage corrected to this build's own client numbers (both previously carried vanilla Classic's higher numbers), Mongoose Bite's old dodge-gate removed (the Forever client's own tooltip, wowhead.com/forever/spell=1495, lists no such requirement), and three previously-unimplemented Survival talent abilities added: Counterattack (parry-triggered, cannot be dodged/parried/blocked), Strider Kick (100% weapon damage, 8s cooldown) and Lacerating Strikes (a bleed on Mongoose Bite). Raptor Strike is still queued at tag 3 (pipeline/apl.py's ON_NEXT_SWING_QUEUE_TAG, the odd one out among the on-next-swing abilities) as the swing-timer weave, gated at 20% mana so it does not starve Mongoose Bite. Counterattack and Mongoose Bite are bare casts -- Counterattack's own ExtraCastCondition only lets it land while its parry-triggered proc aura is up (the same 'free line that falls through otherwise' shape this site's warrior-arms.json already uses for Overpower), and Mongoose Bite's own mana cost and 5s cooldown are gate enough now that the dodge requirement is gone. Strider Kick is the lowest-priority filler on its own 8s cooldown. 2026-09-28 (night-traps): added Immolation Trap (top rank, spell 14305) below Mongoose Bite as an on-cooldown filler now that sim/hunter/immolation_trap.go's ActionIDs are repointed from client-absent placeholder ids to the real ones (13795/14302-14305) and its shared "Traps" category cooldown corrected to the client's 30s -- it lands within Survival's existing 5-yard melee range gate and adds a small ranged-flavored fire DoT on top of the melee weave without contesting Raptor Strike/Mongoose Bite's own priority. There is no spammable melee filler between these cooldowns and Raptor Strike's swing-timer weave -- Classic-era hunters never had one -- so a GCD with nothing else ready is spent on nothing beyond the auto-attack itself, same as live Classic Survival play.

expected_idle.reason: Counterattack only lands while its parry-triggered proc aura is active (hunter.CounterattackProcAura), which only activates off an OnSpellHitTaken parry -- i.e. it requires the TARGET to attack the hunter. This ladder's (and the site's own production sim's) target dummy carries TankIndex: -1 and no SwingSpeed/MinBaseDamage (sim/request/request.go's targetStats/encounter), so it never auto-attacks anyone; nothing in a bare, untanked single-character run can ever trigger a parry, at any level, in any of the 300 iterations. This is a property of the shared encounter builder every spec's ladder run shares, not a defect in this rotation or in sim/hunter/counterattack.go -- Counterattack is correctly wired and dealt real damage in sim/hunter/survival_melee_test.go's own TestCounterattackLevel60ProcsOnParryAndDealsClientDamage, which activates the proc aura directly rather than waiting on an attack that this harness's target never makes.

priorityList.notes: Raptor Strike queued on the swing timer (tag 3, the on-next-swing queue tag), gated at 20% mana so it does not starve Mongoose Bite below.
Counterattack: a bare cast that only lands while its parry-triggered proc aura is active, the same shape warrior-arms.json's own Overpower line uses.
Mongoose Bite on cooldown: no dodge requirement in this build, so its own 5s cooldown and mana cost are the only gates.
Immolation Trap on cooldown: within 5 yards it lands as a melee-range filler, gated only by its own 30-second cooldown and mana cost.
Strider Kick as the lowest-priority filler on its own 8s cooldown.
